messages:
leah_sales: GreenTrust procurement flagged a CAIQ/SIG item: they require HSM-backed customer keys and attestation for any inference cache used during the POC. They say no attestation = no contract. Need a vendor-signed risk acceptance or an alternative.

marc_security: Can you paste the exact questionnaire line?

leah_sales: Quote: 'Does the vendor support customer-managed HSM keys with hardware attestation for transient model caches and any persisted token-like artifacts? If not, provide compensating controls and an official vendor risk acceptance.'

ito_infra: Short answer: hosted mode cannot produce HSM attestation for in-memory caches. Dedicated/Private can attach to customer KMS/HSM for persisted state. We should prepare: (1) customer-friendly paragraph, (2) internal risk memo, (3) timeline for manual attestation artifacts.

sophie_prod: Draft compensating controls (internal) — keep concise:
```
- Ephemeral-only cache: no disk persistence; strict GC on session end.
- Default TTL 45s, configurable to 10s for POC.
- In-memory encryption at process level (AES-GCM with provider KEK), keys rotated frequently.
- CMEK for all persisted blobs (logs/checkpoints) with customer-provided keys.
- mTLS + least-privilege roles between services; JIT credentials for admin ops.
- Immutable audit logs for key/access events stored in customer region, 12mo retention, signed.
- Manual signed runtime integrity snapshot and access log package available on request (3-5 business days).
```

marc_security: Add continuous IDS signatures for key-handling anomalies and immediate revocation playbook. Residual risk: "elevated" for high-regulated customers; "moderate" otherwise. CISO sign-off required for vendor acceptance.

amy_legal: External wording needs soft tone and clear scope. Proposed customer paragraph: "Hosted Redwood inference uses transient, in-memory caches with strict isolation and short TTLs. Hardware-backed attestation for ephemeral memory is available via Dedicated/private deployments; for hosted deployments, Redwood provides customer-managed encryption for persisted artifacts, enhanced auditability, and can furnish a vendor risk acceptance for POC deployments. Please contact your account team for Dedicated/private options." Keep it simple.

leah_sales: GreenTrust needs this by Monday COB. Can we get internal memo + a one-paragraph they can accept?

ito_infra: Feasibility: manual attestation package (signed snapshot + logs) = 3 business days first time, then 1 day for follow-ups. Automation ~8-10 weeks. We can set KV TTL to 10s for the POC this week.

sophie_prod: I will draft the internal risk memo with controls + residual risk statement and a mitigation/remediation plan (automation ETA).

marc_security: I will route SEC-2199 and request reviewers = [marc_security, amy_legal, ciso].

sec-bot: SEC-2199 created and linked to GreenTrust procurement request. Assignees: marc_security, amy_legal, ciso. https://redwood.internal/tickets/SEC-2199

leah_sales: Thanks team. Tagging @marc_security @ito_infra @amy_legal. Sophie, drop the draft customer paragraph here when ready and Ill send to procurement after legal review. :thumbsup:
